adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#destroy`, the diff shows `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` followed by `host.destroy` with no nil-check. If an unknown/already-deleted id is provided, `host` will be `nil` and `nil.destroy` will raise `NoMethodError`, resulting in a 500 instead of a handled 404/422. (The same nil risk also exists in `#update` where `save_host(host)` is called without checking `host`.)
